root_cause.text: In the MediaTek pmdomain function scpsys_get_bus_protection_legacy(), the device tree node returned by of_find_node_with_property() was released with of_node_put() before the syscon_regmap_lookup_by_phandle() error path finished using that same node in dev_err_probe(), causing a use-after-free of the device_node.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves of_node_put(node) from immediately after regmap[2] lookup to after the IS_ERR(regmap[2]) check, and in the error case stores dev_err_probe(..., "%pOF: failed to get infracfg regmap\n", node) in ret before calling of_node_put(node), matching the CVE description that the earlier put could free node before dev_err_probe() dereferenced it.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add an initialized status variable in scpsys_get_bus_protection_legacy to support correct error handling and avoid undefined or missing return-state usage.
intent_record.what: A new local variable declaration, "int ret = 0;", was added to the function scpsys_get_bus_protection_legacy alongside the existing local variables.
intent_record.how: This introduces an initialized integer return/status variable for later use in the function, preventing use of an undeclared or uninitialized variable and ensuring a defined default value of 0 if the variable is subsequently referenced.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a device-tree node reference leak by releasing `node` before returning from the regmap lookup error path.
intent_record.what: The code changes the error handling in the `if (node)` block after `syscon_regmap_lookup_by_phandle(node, "mediatek,infracfg-nao")` by wrapping the `IS_ERR(regmap[2])` path in braces, storing the result of `dev_err_probe(...)` in `ret`, calling `of_node_put(node)` before returning, and moving the unconditional `of_node_put(node)` to execute after the error check.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this ensures the device-tree node reference is always released even when `syscon_regmap_lookup_by_phandle()` fails, preventing a leaked node reference on the error path while preserving the same probe error reporting and return behavior.

The change targets the same error path and the same device-tree node lifetime handling in scpsys_get_bus_protection_legacy(). Although described as fixing a reference leak, it directly modifies when of_node_put(node) happens around the regmap lookup/dev_err_probe path, which is exactly where the use-after-free root cause exists.

This passes the freed device_node to the %pOF formatter after of_node_put(node) already dropped the reference, making the dangling-pointer use explicit.
